'''Jared Fronz''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] relief coordinator during the evacuation of [[Demophon]] prior to the [[Demophon supernova]]. He was grossly fat and sweated profusely, but his soft appearance hid a menacing undercurrent.<ref name="BE" />
